# LegatorOCR v0.2.0-pre.49 (pre-release)

A fresh build after pre.48 was published. **The program code is the same as pre.48**; only the version number changed, so a pre.48 install needs no update. Built and tried by the author's assistant on one Linux machine; the automated tests pass on CI runners. **Nothing was tried by hand on Windows, macOS or arm64.**

**Carried from pre.48**: scanned newspaper PDFs with an explicit mask keep their text; the real 300 dpi is reported; the native OCR cuts tight columns; Find text window (Ctrl+F); decoded pictures are cached while browsing the pages.

**Not verified**: the speed-up in the window on the tester's computer; Windows, macOS, arm64. On the macOS Intel runner (experimental) two PKCS#12 tests fail because of its OpenSSL, unrelated.
